To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Planck HFI detector time streams are dominated by a few families of glitches that are characterized and removed.
the HFI data have been corrected for the effects of high energy particles.
the Planck HFI data have been cleaned of glitches and that the remaining noise in the data is dominated by the 1/f noise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the detection, characterization and removal of energetic particle effects in the HFI time ordered data and the impact of these effects on cosmology.
the characterization, removal and modeling of the energetic particle signal in the Planck data.
the detection of the energetic particle signal, the interpretation of the particle signal in terms of its source, and the development of methods for removing this signal.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HFI data are free of instrumental systematic effects and that the Planck results are not affected by instrumental systematic effects.
we have characterized the energetic particle environment at the L2 orbit for the Planck satellite and have developed a method to remove the effects from the data.
the HFI instrument is performing at the level expected and is not limited by particle effects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have characterized and removed glitches in the HFI data, which has led to an improvement in the noise level of ~20% at 100 GHz.
we have characterized the particle events that affect the instrument and have developed methods for removing them from the HFI time ordered data.

1) the HFI data is dominated by proton induced glitches from the Si die frames supporting the detectors; 2) the proton induced glitches are well described by a three family model; 3) the three family model is a good fit to the data and is used to remove the excess noise from glitches; and 4) we have demonstrated that the three family model does not introduce bias into the data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the HFI data can be cleaned from the effects of energetic particle interactions.
the HFI data is free of any residual energetic particle effects.
the HFI data is free from systematic effects from glitches.
